text:
incident-bot: PAGER: high p99 latency spike on hosted-serving-prod -> model-stream.*. Streaming stalls and increased tail observed. Impact: increased client timeouts. Auto-escalation to eng-sre.

sam: taking a look. seeing p95 480ms -> 900ms, p99 up to 4.1s across us-west-2 clusters.

lee: confirmed. grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/serving/p99?range=1h -> spike started ~1849128800.

morgan: customer-facing: 3 error spikes in last 20m, no full outages but high latency for chat streaming.

sam: logs show repeated KV cache eviction noise on prefill nodes, lots of prefill->decode imbalance. prefill workers filling slots, then decode can't keep up -> backpressure and streaming stalls.

infra-sre: paging note: observed sudden cache fragmentation on shard-17. slab free dropped from 42% -> 8% in 5m. eviction rate x4.

lee: quick hypothesis: prefill batchers pushing large prefixes causing KV hot-slices, prefill wins the slot, decode waits on cache fetch -> stall.

sam: attaching short trace snippet: ```
[1849128902] req=abcd model=model-stream-XL seq=1 prefill_ms=210 decode_ms=1800 kv_fetch_ms=1600 stall=true
[1849128910] req=efgh model=model-stream-XL seq=1 prefill_ms=200 decode_ms=950 kv_fetch_ms=900 stall=true
```

morgan: customer impact estimate: ~6% of requests hit p99>3s, about 12 customers saw degraded interactive experience (chat).

sam: immediate mitigations we can try: 1) throttle prefill concurrency on affected nodes 2) temporarily increase decode worker pool 3) move traffic off shard-17 -> fallback routing 4) bump KV eviction threshold to avoid aggressive slab churn.

lee: I'll try (1) and (3) now. reducing prefill concurrency via infra toggle: `curl -XPOST https://infra-api/feature/pre_fill_concurrency -d '{"shard":17, "limit":2}'`

deploy-bot: Feature toggle applied to shard-17 by lee (id:toggle-4827).

infra-sre: routing change prep: `routectl shift --from shard-17 --to shard-12 --pct 40` -> staging first then ramp.

sam: rolling 40% off to shard-12 now. will watch p95/p99.

(5m pass)

morgan: initial signal: p99 down from 4.1s -> 2.6s after 40% shift. user reports reduced stalls.

lee: prefill throttle seemed to cut eviction spikes. slab free stabilizing at ~18%.

sam: still seeing decode queue length elevated. infra-sre can you spin up 2 extra decode workers for node pool decode-XL?

infra-sre: provisioning now: `k scale deployment/decode-XL --replicas=+2 -n serving` -> done.

deploy-bot: HorizontalScale executed by infra-sre for deployment/decode-XL -> new replicas ready.

sam: after scale, p95 ~520ms, p99 ~1.3s. streaming stalls significantly reduced.

morgan: customer note: CS notified for affected customers with ETA for full stabilization.

lee: runbook follow-ups: 1) create short-term flag to limit prefill window length for heavy prompts 2) adjust KV slab allocation thresholds to be less aggressive 3) add alert for slab-free <15% per shard 4) postmortem if recurrence.

sam: handoff to next oncall @lee in 15m for monitoring + roadmap tickets. I'll update incident doc with mitigation timeline.

lee: taking oncall. I'll keep watch for 30m and rollback routing if regress.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: tags=[kv-cache, slab-frag, prefill-decode, p99-latency], severity=sev2, incident_doc=https://incidents/internal/1849129999

morgan: thanks all. good quick coordination. :thumbsup:
